name: ai-bridge
description: Connect web AI chats (DeepSeek, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Mistral, Qwen, Kimi) — or a local Ollama model — to VS Code, with a built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) client for external tools and a local semantic code index

untrustedWorkspaces.description: AI Bridge writes files, runs shell commands and controls a browser — it requires a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Requires a local file system and an installed browser.

commands.title: AI Bridge: Clear No-Ask File List
AI Bridge: Setup Local Whisper (offline STT)

aiBridge.provider.description: The AI provider used by the chat. "auto" = try the last web provider through Chrome, then fall back automatically to local Ollama; web providers run through Chrome; `ollama` runs locally, without a browser.

aiBridge.ollamaModel.description: The Ollama model used by the local provider (e.g. qwen2.5-coder:7b).

aiBridge.aiSelectorFinder.markdownDescription: When the classic selector healer fails completely (no valid candidate), sends a cleaned DOM snapshot to **local Ollama** (`aiBridge.ollamaModel`) to discover new selectors. Proposed selectors are validated in the real page, used immediately and saved to `selectors-user.json` (globalStorage). Requires Ollama running; any failure does not block the normal flow.

aiBridge.aiFinderTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Timeout (seconds, 5–300) for the AI selector analysis. After it expires, the AI fallback is abandoned and the healer returns null.

aiBridge.cdpPort.description: The CDP port Chrome is started on / connected to (default 9222).

aiBridge.chromePath.description: Path to Chrome/Edge (empty = automatic detection on Windows/macOS/Linux).

aiBridge.messageTimeoutMinutes.description: Total time budget (minutes) for one message in the agentic loop.

aiBridge.autoVerify.markdownDescription: After every file write (`write_file` / `edit_file` / `write_files`), automatically verifies the project (`astro check`, `tsc --noEmit` or the detected build/typecheck/lint script). On failure, the full error is sent to the AI for auto-repair (max **3 attempts**); if the repair fails, the changes are rolled back automatically (**rollback** to the last verified-good state).

aiBridge.promptCheckpoints.markdownDescription: Before every message, creates a **git checkpoint** (commit `aibridge-prompt:<id>` with the entire working tree) and shows the ⟲ button above the message, to return to that state (`git reset --hard`, with an automatic backup of the current state before the reset). In folders without git, the repo is initialized automatically (see `aiBridge.autoInitGit`).

aiBridge.autoInitGit.markdownDescription: If the project folder is not a git repo yet, initializes it automatically (`git init` + a minimal `.gitignore`, only if missing) on the first message, so checkpoints and the ⟲ restore button always work. Disable if you don't want AI Bridge to create a git repo in the project.

aiBridge.selectorsUrl.markdownDescription: **Raw** URL of a public GitHub Gist with `selectors.json` (same structure as the bundled one + `version`/`updated`/`changelog`). Empty = remote selectors disabled — only the selectors bundled with the extension are used. Example: `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/<user>/<id>/raw/selectors.json`

aiBridge.checkSelectorsOnStartup.markdownDescription: On startup, checks whether the Gist in `aiBridge.selectorsUrl` has a newer selector version. Rate limiting: at most once every 24 hours — the "AI Bridge: Update Selectors" command works anytime, on demand. Only takes effect if the URL is set.

aiBridge.humanTyping.markdownDescription: "Human" typing in the chat box: random delays between characters, pauses at punctuation and occasional fast bursts (anti-detect). Disabled = instant paste (`insertText`). Very long messages (over 1500 characters, e.g. attachments) are pasted directly.

aiBridge.humanBehavior.markdownDescription: "Human" behavior before actions: small mouse movements toward the pressed button (input box, new chat, stop) and occasional light scrolling (anti-detect).

aiBridge.mutationObserver.markdownDescription: Uses `MutationObserver` for fast detection (experimental — can be flaky with offscreen Chrome: JS is suspended for invisible windows). Disabled = classic 500ms polling (reliable). Recommended: `false`.

aiBridge.autoAcceptPopups.markdownDescription: Automatically closes consent popups (cookie / terms / "OK" / "Got it" / "Accept all"…) after a page loads and before typing in the chat. Safe matches only: visible buttons, exact acceptance texts at 3 confidence tiers ("OK" only inside dialogs); **Reject / Only necessary / Customize / Not now** texts are ignored completely.

aiBridge.sttLanguage.markdownDescription: Language for **voice input** (the 🎤 button in the chat): the recording is transcribed **locally, offline, with Whisper** and added to the message box. `ro-RO` = Romanian, `en-US` = English.

aiBridge.whisperCliPath.markdownDescription: Path to `whisper-cli` (whisper.cpp) for offline voice input. Empty = automatic detection: globalStorage (`whisper/bin`) → classic whisper.cpp locations → PATH.

aiBridge.whisperModelPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Whisper ggml model (e.g. `ggml-base.bin`). Empty = automatic detection: globalStorage (`whisper/models`) → next to the CLI → `whisper.cpp/models`.

aiBridge.whisperTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Timeout (seconds) for one Whisper transcription. On expiry, the process is stopped and the error is reported in the chat.

aiBridge.mcpEnabled.markdownDescription: Starts the configured **MCP (Model Context Protocol)** servers and exposes their tools to the AI agent as extra tools (`mcp_<server>_<tool>`). Servers are configured in `.vscode/mcp.json` (format `{"servers": {...}}`) or in the `aiBridge.mcpServers` setting. Every MCP call requires approval (automatic only with ⚡ auto-approve enabled).

aiBridge.mcpToolTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Timeout (seconds) for one MCP tool call (`tools/call`). On expiry, the call is reported as an error to the AI.

aiBridge.semanticIndex.enabled.markdownDescription: Enables **semantic code search** (the `search_semantic` tool + the index commands). The workspace is embedded locally with Ollama (`nomic-embed-text` by default) and stored as a JSON vector store in globalStorage — no new npm dependencies. Disabled = the AI falls back to `search_files`.

aiBridge.semanticIndex.model.markdownDescription: Ollama embedding model used for the semantic index (install with `ollama pull nomic-embed-text`). Changing it invalidates the existing index — re-run **AI Bridge: Index Workspace**.

aiBridge.semanticIndex.onSave.markdownDescription: Automatically re-indexes a file when it is **saved** (incremental — only that file's chunks are recomputed, debounced 1.5 s). Requires an existing index; does nothing if the workspace was never indexed.

aiBridge.semanticIndex.maxFileKb.markdownDescription: Files larger than this (in KB) are skipped when indexing (they are recorded as skipped, not embedded).

aiBridge.semanticIndex.topK.markdownDescription: Number of chunks returned by `search_semantic` (top-K by cosine similarity).

aiBridge.semanticIndex.exclude.markdownDescription: Extra directory/file **names** to exclude from indexing, on top of the built-in list (`node_modules`, `.git`, `out`, `dist`, `build`, `.next`, `coverage`, `venv`, `target`, lockfiles, minified files…). Example: `["fixtures", "snapshots"]`.
